cubic_near_double_roots.description: numpy.roots root classification (|imag| < 1e-10 is real, then > B) near the boundaries of the three-real-root region. Near a double root the eigenvalue solver has an error of order sqrt(eps) * scale, so the count it reports there is a numerical artefact; Rust must agree wherever the root pair is separated by more than the stated band.
